text_en: David and the officers of the army also set apart for the service the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with lyres, harps, and cymbals. The list of those who did the work and of their duties was:
text_cn: 达味与掌管礼仪的首长，也给阿撒夫、赫曼和耶杜通的子孙分派了任务，要他们以琴瑟、铙钹（náo bó）奏圣乐。任职的人数如下：

text_en: Of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, sons of Asaph, under the direction of Asaph, who prophesied under the direction of the king.
text_cn: 阿撒夫的子孙：匝雇尔、约色夫、乃塔尼雅和阿沙勒拉，都是阿撒夫的子孙，归阿撒夫指挥；阿撒夫则照君王的指示奏圣乐。

text_en: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with the lyre in thanksgiving and praise to the Lord .
text_cn: 属耶杜通的，有耶杜通的子孙革达里雅、责黎、耶沙雅、史米、哈沙彼雅、玛提提雅，一共六人，都归他们的父亲耶杜通指挥。耶杜通弹琴奏乐，称谢颂扬上主。

text_en: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, Mahazioth.
text_cn: 属赫曼的，有赫曼的子孙步克雅、玛塔尼雅、乌齐耳、叔巴耳、耶黎摩特、哈纳尼雅、哈纳尼、厄里雅达、基达耳提、洛玛默提厄则尔、约市贝卡沙、玛罗提、曷提尔和玛哈齐约特。

text_en: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer, according to the promise of God to exalt him; for God had given Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
text_cn: 这些人都是那奉天主命，作君王“先见者”的赫曼的儿子，天主为使他有能力，赐给了他十四个儿子和三个女儿。

text_en: They were all under the direction of their father for the music in the house of the Lord with cymbals, harps, and lyres for the service of the house of God. Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman were under the order of the king.
text_cn: 这些人皆归他们的父亲指挥，在上主的殿内，以铙、钹、琴、瑟演奏圣乐。在天主的圣殿供职时，受君王指示的是阿撒夫、耶杜通和赫曼。

text_en: They and their kindred, who were trained in singing to the Lord , all of whom were skillful, numbered two hundred eighty-eight.
text_cn: 这些人连同他们在歌咏上主的事上，受过特殊训练的弟兄，共计二百八十八人。

text_en: And they cast lots for their duties, small and great, teacher and pupil alike.
text_cn: 这些人，不分大小，不分师生，一律以抽签分派职务。

text_en: The first lot fell for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, to him and his brothers and his sons, twelve;
text_cn: 首先中签的是属阿撒夫的约色夫，他与他的兄弟及他的儿子共十二人；次为革达里雅，他与他的兄弟及他的儿子共十二人；

text_en: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 三为匝雇尔，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 四为依责黎，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 五为乃塔尼雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 六为步克雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the seventh to Jesarelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 七为耶沙勒拉，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 八为耶沙雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 九为玛塔尼雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十为史米，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十一为阿匝勒耳，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十二为哈沙彼雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十三为叔巴耳，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十四为玛提提雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the fifteenth, to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十五为耶黎摩特，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the sixteenth, to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十六为哈纳尼雅，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the seventeenth, to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十七为约市贝卡沙，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the eighteenth, to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十八为哈纳尼，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the nineteenth, to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 十九为玛罗提，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the twentieth, to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 二十为厄里雅达，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the twenty-first, to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 二十一为曷提尔，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the twenty-second, to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 二十二为基达耳提，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the twenty-third, to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;
text_cn: 二十三为玛哈齐约特，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人；

text_en: to the twenty-fourth, to Romamti-ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
text_cn: 二十四为洛玛默提厄则尔，他与他的儿子及他的兄弟共十二人。
